---
title: "Interactive table"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: library
library(DT)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: read data
df <- read_csv("data/formatted_eclipses.csv")
```

```{r}
datatable(
  df,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 5,
    scrollX = TRUE
  ),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```
